name: assembly_recovery
question: At equal training cost, does adaptive practice on recoverable failures reduce unfinished assembly jobs more than uniform practice and simple retract/retry?

training.bootstrap_cost: Count in each arm or explicitly report identical shared initialization cost
training.adaptive_priority_initial: p * (1 - p) with nonzero bin sampling floor; learning progress is a separate ablation

splits.fault_support_status: Must specify numeric ranges and held-out combinations before freezing; seeds alone do not establish out-of-distribution testing

job_protocol.force_budget_meaning: Experimental limit on raw incoming wrist-joint load; not fixture normal force, hardware damage, or a safety rating
job_protocol.force_sampling_and_abort_latency: Raw wrist load sampled at every 1/120 s physics step; evaluator latches hold for the next control application. No measured guarantee of a hard force ceiling or stopping distance.
job_protocol.recovery_definition: Witnessed contact failure followed by retained-grasp withdrawal and settled reinsertion within the same job. Evaluator stall proxy alone is insufficient. One scripted development case is now verified in evidence/recovery_pair_10070_r02.json.
job_protocol.evaluator_defaults_source: src/assembly_recovery/evaluation.py:JobCriteria; actual resolved values are recorded in every validation report
job_protocol.development_reward_terminal_handling: Only control reward endpoints at/before evaluator termination; later rewards zero, no bootstrap. Partial terminal interval omitted. Training integration is not implemented.

success_target.interpretation: Engineering ambition, not a promised result or publication gate

gate_evidence.held_part_gravity_resolved: evidence/peg_validation.json: select physical held-part gravity; three development seeds retain bilateral contact. Robot gravity compensation is idealized.
gate_evidence.within_job_reset_accounting_verified: evidence/peg_validation.json: explicit reset/write guards and a 12-second run beyond the upstream reset horizon; raw physics traces replay identically.
gate_evidence.success_and_force_evaluator_verified: evidence/peg_validation.json and CPU tests: dwell, raw wrist-load abort, bilateral grasp loss, failure precedence, trace continuity. Development criteria, not hardware force certification.
gate_evidence.actor_information_audited: Adapter probes and every recorded retry decision replay from the 24-scalar noisy actor vector; evaluator-only fixture/finger contact is excluded. Keep this gate false until the training wrapper and all transforms are audited.
gate_evidence.fault_support_validated: One unique seed 10070 fault case completes contact stall, withdrawal and reinsertion; another retained-grasp search stays >3.25 mm off-centre and times out. Numeric fault bins and cross-development-seed support remain unvalidated.
gate_evidence.recovery_reward_compatibility_verified: evidence/recovery_pair_10070_r02.json and evidence/reward_audit.json: one witnessed scripted recovery returns 75.797 vs 37.543 for a bitwise-matched persistent stall at gamma 0.995. Narrow development trajectory gate only; training terminal integration and wider fault support remain open.
